thread:
Sam (Partner Ops): Quick sync — ThetaSI routed two active marketplace leads (ACME Inc, Halcyon Systems). Need clear owner assignment + ROE for co-sell vs SI-led. Devon / Maria, any objections to marking ACME as AE-owned and Halcyon as joint?

Devon (SalesOps): I'm fine w/ AE-owned for ACME if Aj confirms. Halcyon looks like joint — they want private deploy + SI integration work.

Aj (Account Exec): Confirmed on ACME — buyer expects Redwood to own contract/legal. Halcyon is heavier on integration; I'd call that joint for now.

Maria (Partnerships): Proposed quick rules to codify: 1) If customer requests Redwood to own contract -> AE-owned. 2) If SI provides >40% of implementation/TCV -> SI-led. 3) Otherwise -> joint. We should update SFDC tags and a 1-page handoff checklist.

Iris (Solutions): Add one more: if account already has production Redwood infra, default to AE-owned unless SI is building new platform components. Also we need explicit SOW owner field.

Sam (Partner Ops): I'll draft the SOP. Quick tech ask: which SFDC fields do we set? Example names?

Devon (SalesOps): Use record type `Opportunity - Partner`. Set `Partner_Owner__c` + `CoSell_Role__c`. Example snippet to keep consistent: 
```
update:
  recordType = "Opportunity - Partner"
  fields:
    Partner_Owner__c = "ThetaSI"
    CoSell_Role__c = "Integrator"
    HandOff_TS__c = "1765432100"
```
(also add `Partner_Contribution__c` with % estimate)

Aj (Account Exec): Sounds good. Also Halcyon has asked about a co-branded announcement in Q3. Maria — can Partnerships own comms + legal NDAs?

Maria (Partnerships): Yep. I'll loop in Growth + Legal. Need ThetaSI signoff on quote usage.

Sam (Partner Ops): ThetaSI said they're ok with a joint quote but want approval flow documented. I'll add an approval step to the SOP.

deploy-bot: reminder set: follow-up on SOP draft in 7 days (1766036900) :alarm_clock:

Iris (Solutions): For the handoff checklist please include: intro call owner, technical POC, SOW owner, billing owner, and a short migration/enablement timeline. Link to runbook: https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/partner-handoff

Sam (Partner Ops): Thanks — I'll update SFDC for both ACME and Halcyon, publish the 1-pager in #partnerships, and ping once handoff and tags are live. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
